# dont

> Rust CLI for forcing epistemic discipline in autonomous LLM workflows. Gives agents an explicit state machine for claims and terms so ungrounded assertions don't quietly become accepted project truth.

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, design decisions, planning, and review.

Leer en español: https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/
